note: Fact templates for the scenario compiler. {TOKEN} and {token} are a generated word pair in upper and lower case, {alt}, {ALT}, and {Alt} a second word in lower, upper, and Pascal case, {value} and {value2} distinct five-digit numbers, and {codename} an adjective-noun-NN codename. A template's variants list binds further placeholders, one entry per instance in turn. probe_variants and out_probe_variants list further tasks under the same rule, so the n-th repeat of a task text in one project asks the n-th variant instead of the work the agent already did; a repeat past the list keeps the text behind a framing. A tool_result script is a program the agent runs that defines the error identity the check names and raises it, so the identity exists in the repository and the failure is one the script produces. When a template repeats in one project, the later instance is conveyed through revise, whose {old_*} placeholders name the previous instance's values. A check's must and must_not regexes apply to the added lines of the agent's diff, paths_must and paths_must_not to the paths of the files the diff adds or changes, first_line_must to the first line of every file the diff adds, quote_style_must (double or single) to the delimiter of every string literal in the added lines, commands_must and commands_must_not to the command log, an optional scope (a directory prefix ending in /, or one file path) restricts a check's diff-channel keys to files under that prefix or to that file, and an optional applies lists regexes for the constructs a rule governs (a new public constant, a returned error string, a log call): each match in the scoped added lines, extended over its open brackets, is one unit, and the rule holds only when a unit exists and every unit matches every must regex; and answer, answer_must_not, abstain, and judge checks to the final assistant text of the agent call record the proxy captures. A lookup template's concept is one word naming the fact's subject; its statement, revise, and probe each carry that word, and its probe names no placeholder, so the question identifies the fact without stating its value. A plan template names a task; the compiler composes plan statements from one or two tasks. A tool_error template has form tool_result (a committed script the agent runs) or pasted (a failure transcript the user pastes). Every rust, typescript, and go template carries requires, the constructs its tasks presuppose: each entry names a file path and a regex that the file must match at the pinned commit of every repository of that language and of its twin; the compiler refuses a bank whose requirement a pinned tree lacks.

rejected.statement: reading the body with io.ReadAll to measure it was tried and backed out because it buffered the whole body before the size cap applied
rejected.probe: Make RequestSize log how many body bytes the handler actually read, once the handler returns.

rejected.statement: an unsafe pointer cast for request paths went in once and came out again after the race detector flagged shared byte buffers
rejected.probe: Make route matching cheaper when request paths are several kilobytes long.

rejected.statement: math/rand once supplied request ID suffixes, and we reverted it after two hosts produced colliding sequences
rejected.probe: Make RequestID end each generated ID with a few unpredictable characters.

rejected.statement: setting response headers by indexing w.Header() directly was tried and dropped because it skipped key canonicalisation and broke later lookups
rejected.probe: Add a response header carrying the matched route pattern on every request the router serves.

rejected.statement: starting middleware side work from context.Background was tried and backed out because it ignored the client's cancellation
rejected.probe: Make Heartbeat call a health-check function its caller supplies, under a short time limit, before it answers.

rejected.statement: stopping the process with log.Fatal or os.Exit on bad middleware settings was tried and reverted because it skipped the host server's deferred cleanup
rejected.probe: Make Compress refuse, at setup time, a compression level that gzip does not support.
